# Draft:Kingswood and Fishponds

Kingswood and Fishponds is a built up area containing the town of Kingswood in South Gloucestershire and the suburb of Fishponds in Bristol. As of 2011 it had a combined population of 160,270 . It also contains the villages of Downend , Cadbury Heath and Hanham all in South Gloucestershire .
